item.title: New Android safety tool warns users against opening banking apps during suspicious calls
item.description: Google’s new Android feature warns you when opening banking apps during calls from unknown numbers- a clever move to stop real-time phone scams in their tracks. Could this finally save users from losing money to live scam calls?

item.title: Heavy snowfall grips North India as Kedarnath drops to -13°C; Here’s full weather update
item.description: A fresh western disturbance and strong jet streams have brought sharp weather changes across North India. Heavy snowfall in Himalayan states, especially Kedarnath where temperatures plunged to -13°C, has intensified cold conditions in plains as well.

item.title: Trump hits out at EU for X penalty; Claims Europe is ‘Heading the Wrong Way’
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump sharply criticized the European Union after the EU imposed a $140 million fine on X. He said Europe is “heading in a very bad direction” and warned that rising immigration could change its identity.

item.title: Who are the Luthra brothers behind the Goa nightclub fire that killed 25?
item.description: A tragic fire at a Goa nightclub claimed 25 lives, including staff and tourists. The club, owned by Delhi-based Luthra brothers Saurabh and Gaurav was found violating fire safety norms. Both owners fled to Thailand within hours of the incident.

item.title: SP MP Iqra Hasan explains true meaning of ‘Vande Mataram’, Hits out at Centre
item.description: In the Lok Sabha, a discussion was held on 150 years of 'Vande Mataram', where SP MP Iqra Hasan delivered a sharp critique of the government. She explained the meaning of the hymn, questioned its politicization, and said Indian Muslims are “Indians by choice.”

item.title: Donald Trump threatens India with new tariffs amid India-Russia ties; Click for details
item.description: US President Donald Trump has threatened India with additional tariffs on rice, escalating tensions amid India-Russia deepening ties. India already faces 50% US tariffs, including 25% on Russian oil imports.

item.description: IPL 2026 mini auction shortlist revealed with 350 players from 1,390 registrations. Quinton de Kock makes surprise comeback as BCCI confirms December 16 Abu Dhabi event. Get complete details on auction format, player pool, and team strategies.

item.title: IndiGo Crisis: Over 200 flights cancelled; Aviation Minister orders reduction in IndiGo routes
item.description: IndiGo's operational crisis continued for the eighth day. ​​On Tuesday, approximately 180 flights were cancelled from Bengaluru and Hyderabad, while a total of over 230 flights were affected across the country.

item.title: Bigg Boss fame Zeeshan Khan’s car hit by another vehicle; Latest update here
item.description: Bigg Boss OTT fame actor Zeeshan Khan was involved in a car accident in Mumbai's Versova area on Monday night. The collision was so severe that the airbags deployed, but the actor escaped unharmed.
